newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Express sets 16-for-100 issue.
newsitem.headline: Korea Express sets 16-for-100 issue.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Express Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would offer a 16-for-100 rights issue in December.
The issue will increase paid-in capital to 72 billion won from 60 billion.
A company statement said it planned to issue 2.4 million new common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of October 26.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for December 3 and 4, with payment due by December 6.
